title: decision-support-rarity: Risk-aware active learning under class rarity (ESWA companion software, v2.0.0)
description: Companion software for the paper Risk-aware active learning under class rarity: A decision framework and cross-domain evaluation for expert systems (Expert Systems with Applications). It implements a strictly paired-trajectory protocol, an acquisition-risk profile reporting the lower quantile and the material-loss probability, a non-maximized discovery oracle with an exploitability ratio, and evidence-graded guidelines, evaluated over 27 acquisition strategies and three downstream learners on a controlled synthetic grid, 42 real tabular datasets with preserved rarity, and 17 image tasks on two frozen embeddings.
